newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Airport Authority awards new airport contracts.
newsitem.headline: HK Airport Authority awards new airport contracts.

text.p: The Airport Authority said on Thursday it had awarded two contracts worth a total HK$265.5 million for construction related to the new airport.
The first contract worth HK$137.5 million for the northwest concourse extension associated with the second runway at Chak Lap Kok went to Franki Contractors Ltd, it said in a statement.
Franki is a unit of Bilfinger + Berger AG.

The second contract worth HK$128 million went to Dickson-China Harbour Joint Venture for the construction and maintenance of storage for aircraft recovery equipment and for the airfield ground maintenance building, it said.
Dickson-China Harbour is a joint venture between Dickson Construction International Ltd and China Harbour Engineer Co. Ltd.
